questions.stem: Why do lipids store more energy per gram than carbohydrates?

options.text: Lipids contain more water molecules than carbohydrates
Lipids are larger molecules so they always contain more energy
Lipids have a higher proportion of carbon-hydrogen bonds, which release more energy when broken
Lipids are soluble in water, making them easier to break down

questions.explanation: Lipids have a higher proportion of carbon-hydrogen bonds compared to carbohydrates. These bonds store a lot of chemical energy, so more energy is released per gram when lipids are oxidised during respiration.
